title: Design System: Wheeler Cat — Variant F (signature-gesture extension)

variant.bet: Cat® dealer-chain identity extended from logo confinement into a structural system — Cat-triangle motif as eyebrow mark and section-divider rule; Wheeler wordmark wipes at footer; chain-affiliation made visible without invention
variant.capturedTraitAmplified: dealer-chain identity (Wheeler is one of 50+ Caterpillar US dealers; the chain identity is currently confined to the logo + 'Cat' in copy)
variant.evidence: voice.heroHeadline contains 'Cat®' wordmark trademark; CTA samples include 'CAT® CARD IS NOW CAT® COMMERCIAL ACCOUNT' (h3); 'parts.cat.com' is a captured nav target; brand register is bold-direct dealer-aligned

differentiationFrom.A: A applies the improvements as systemic fixes; F introduces Cat-triangle eyebrow motif on every section + footer wordmark wipe. 3 diffs: section eyebrow vocabulary (none in A vs triangle-marked in F), footer composition (link grid in A vs wordmark plate in F), header treatment (captured chrome in A vs triangle-marked nav dividers in F).
differentiationFrom.D: D extends type scope; F extends gesture scope. 3 diffs: F preserves captured type scale; F adds Cat-triangle motif (not in D); F's footer wordmark wipe is a divergent composition primitive D doesn't carry.
differentiationFrom.rationale: F is captured-evidence-driven: the Cat® wordmark and Caterpillar's iconic equilateral triangle are already in the brand's identity inheritance. F surfaces them as structural language.

signatureGesture.rationale: F's bet — extend Cat® chain-identity from logo + copy into a structural system. No invented marks (Cat-triangle is the Caterpillar corporate identity, in public use across every dealer); no invented wordmarks (Wheeler wordmark is captured).

marks.form: equilateral triangle, point-up, 12px on a side at default; renders as a hairline yellow stroke or solid yellow fill
marks.usedAs: eyebrow mark before every section title; section-divider rule (triangle row at 24px spacing across the section boundary); footer wordmark anchor
marks.fallback: if triangle SVG is not safely renderable inline, render as the Unicode equivalent ▲ in Roboto Condensed 700 with kerning 0.1em
marks.rationale: Cat-triangle is the strongest unowned-by-Wheeler-but-shared-by-the-dealer-chain identity element. Using it brand-faithfully signals dealer affiliation without inventing a Wheeler-specific motif.

marks.form: Wheeler logo at 4× scale (1072×268) on a dark-on-yellow plate; positioned as footer wordmark with clip-path wipe-up on scroll into footer
marks.usedAs: footer hero plate — replaces the standard footer link grid as the visual anchor; link grid retreats to a sub-band below the wordmark
marks.rationale: Captured logo is reused as-is (Mode A image-reuse contract); only its scale and position are direction-authorized.

header.treatment: every nav link prefixed with cat-triangle eyebrow mark in yellow at 6px; dividers between links are triangle-row instead of vertical pipe
header.rationale: Chain-identity marker enters the navigation chrome

sectionHeads.pattern: ▲ EYEBROW · h2 SECTION TITLE — every section opens with a cat-triangle eyebrow mark (8px yellow filled) followed by the captured eyebrow text
sectionHeads.rationale: Marks the page rhythm; readers learn the triangle = chain-identity in 2 sections

sectionDividers.pattern: between bands, a row of cat-triangles at 24px spacing (yellow hairline stroke at #FFCC00, 1px) spanning the section gutter
sectionDividers.rationale: Replaces the captured pattern of plain whitespace gutters with a structural rule that ties section transitions to chain-identity

footer.composition: Wheeler wordmark plate (4× scale) at top of footer on yellow #FFCC00 band; below the plate, captured 3-col link grid (QUICK LINKS / CONTACT US / CONNECT WITH US) on dark #272727
footer.wordmarkTreatment: static under F (no clip-path wipe — that would belong to a cinematic sibling); wordmark sits anchored at top edge of footer band
footer.rationale: Wordmark becomes the brand summary; link grid demoted to functional

hits.justification: Triangles are not side stripes — they are typographic / iconographic marks. The triangle-row at 24px spacing is a brand-identity gesture, not a decorative stripe. Rule does not fire.

antiToolboxAudit.rationale: Single bet (chain-identity gesture extension). One adjacent-rule check, cleared with citation. Cat-triangle is captured brand inheritance (Caterpillar's shared dealer identity), not invented.
